dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, our stall is too busy at lunchtime. What if we opened a second branch?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aʊr ˈstɔːl ɪz ˈtuː ˈbɪzi ət ˈlʌntʃtaɪm. ˈwʌt ɪf wiː ˈoʊpənd ə ˈsɛkənd ˈbræntʃ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Where? There's a lot of competition near the main gate.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛr? ðɛrz ə ˈlɑːt əv ˌkɑːmpəˈtɪʃən ˈnɪr ðə ˈmeɪn ˈɡeɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Suppose we opened one near the hospital? There aren't many competitors there.
dialogue.reading: səˈpoʊz wiː ˈoʊpənd ˈwʌn ˈnɪr ðə ˈhɑːspɪtəl? ðɛr ˈɑːrnt ˈmɛni kəmˈpɛtɪtərz ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's true, but the rent would be expensive.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtruː, bʌt ðə ˈrɛnt wʊd bi ɪkˈspɛnsɪv.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. What if we launched an app instead? Customers could order online.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈwʌt ɪf wiː ˈlɔːntʃt ən ˈæp ɪnˈstɛd? ˈkʌstəmərz kʊd ˈɔːrdər ˌɑːnˈlaɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Apps are expensive, too. And suppose nobody downloaded it?
dialogue.reading: ˈæps ər ɪkˈspɛnsɪv, ˈtuː. ənd səˈpoʊz ˈnoʊbɑːdi ˌdaʊnˈloʊdɪd ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hmm. What about a partnership with a café? We could sell our boxes there.
dialogue.reading: ˈhm. ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ə ˈpɑːrtnərʃɪp wɪð ə kæˈfeɪ? wiː kʊd ˈsɛl aʊr ˈbɑːksɪz ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I like that. But what if the café wanted half of our profit?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlaɪk ˈðæt. bʌt ˈwʌt ɪf ðə kæˈfeɪ ˈwɑːntɪd ˈhæf əv aʊr ˈprɑːfɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Then we'd say no! We could offer them 20%.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn wiːd ˈseɪ ˈnoʊ! wiː kʊd ˈɔːfər ðɛm ˈtwɛnti pərˈsɛnt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. And what if our competitors copied our idea?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd ˈwʌt ɪf aʊr kəmˈpɛtɪtərz ˈkɑːpid aʊr aɪˈdiːə?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: They can't copy our recipes. Our food is healthier and more delicious!
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈkænt ˈkɑːpi aʊr ˈrɛsəpiz. aʊr ˈfuːd ɪz ˈhɛlθiər ənd ˈmɔːr dɪˈlɪʃəs!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: True. Let's talk to the café owner tomorrow.
dialogue.reading: ˈtruː. ˈlɛts ˈtɔːk tə ðə kæˈfeɪ ˈoʊnər təˈmɑːroʊ.
